claim_scope: In-project directed FIFO observation enclosure and finite-response coupling; no global novelty claim.

primary_sources.title: E. J. McShane, Extension of Range of Functions (1934)
primary_sources.supports: Classical Lipschitz extension by supremum of metric cones. Does not establish our particular interval/FIFO/route statement.

primary_sources.title: Brian C. Dean, Shortest Paths in FIFO Time-Dependent Networks: Theory and Algorithms
primary_sources.supports: Nondecreasing arc arrival maps with arrival >= departure; FIFO path composition and time-dependent shortest path setting.

primary_sources.title: Shortest paths in a network with time-dependent flow speeds (2000)
primary_sources.location: The model / Non-passing travel time / The algorithm
primary_sources.supports: Distance-integrated time-dependent speed model satisfies nonpassing and admits a Dijkstra variant.

wolfram.meaning: One oriented triangle inequality case; not independent proof of the whole theorem.
